raw_text: Recorded Future threat intelligence has identified the ransomware strain used in the Indian oil pipeline attack as a modified variant of BlackCat/ALPHV. Our analysis links the initial access broker activity to a known threat actor tracked as UNC3944. The command and control infrastructure overlaps with previously documented campaigns targeting energy sector OT networks. Full IOC package available to subscribers.
clean_text: Recorded Future identifies ransomware as BlackCat/ALPHV variant. Initial access linked to UNC3944 threat actor. C2 infrastructure overlaps with previous energy sector OT campaigns.
